description: MainActivity.java is a core source file for an Android application demonstrating media routing, playback control, and remote media management. It contains the main activity class that manages media routing, user interface for media selection and playback, integration with media router APIs, remote control client registration, and media control handling.

classes.name: MainActivity
classes.description: Main activity handling media routing, controls, UI updates, remote control client registration, and user interactions for media playback.

classes.name: DiscoveryFragment
classes.description: A fragment for media route discovery that observes route changes and can set callback for route events.

classes.name: MediaItem
classes.description: Represents a media resource with name, URI, and MIME type.

classes.name: PlaylistItem
classes.description: Represents an item in the playlist, holding media details, position, duration, state, and timestamps.

classes.name: LibraryAdapter
classes.description: Adapter for rendering media library items, allowing adding items to the playlist.

classes.name: PlaylistAdapter
classes.description: Adapter for rendering playlist items, allowing removal of items.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes activity, sets up media router, route selector, UI components, adapters, media files, and remote control client.

methods.name: registerRemoteControlClient
methods.description: Registers the RemoteControlClient with AudioManager and MediaRouter, sets playback state flags.

methods.name: unregisterRemoteControlClient
methods.description: Unregisters the RemoteControlClient from system services.

methods.name: handleMediaKey
methods.description: Handles hardware/media key events for playback control.

methods.name: updateProgress
methods.description: Updates the SeekBar position based on current playback position and timestamps.

methods.name: updateUi
methods.description: Refreshes UI elements for playlist, route info, and control buttons.

methods.name: updatePlaylist
methods.description: Syncs playlist adapter with current playlist.

methods.name: updateRouteDescription
methods.description: Updates textual description of currently selected route.

methods.name: updateButtons
methods.description: Enables or disables playback control buttons based on current state.

methods.name: getCheckedPlaylistItem
methods.description: Returns the currently selected playlist item if any.
